description: This file implements the server-side code for the login page of an online examination system, handling user login logic for students and teachers, including database access for student authentication and static checks for teacher/admin login.

classes.name: LoginPage
classes.description: Partial class representing the login page code-behind, handling user authentication logic.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Event handler for page load, currently does nothing.

methods.name: signupB
methods.description: Handles the signup button click event, transfers users to the Sign Up page.

methods.name: loginButton_Click
methods.description: Handles login button click, authenticates users as students via database query or as teachers/admin via static credentials, and redirects accordingly.
